Source code for refcount_warn_saturate:
void refcount_warn_saturate(refcount_t *r, enum refcount_saturation_type t)
{
	refcount_set(r, REFCOUNT_SATURATED);

	switch (t) {
	case REFCOUNT_ADD_NOT_ZERO_OVF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("saturated; leaking memory");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_ADD_OVF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("saturated; leaking memory");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_ADD_UAF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("addition on 0; use-after-free");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_SUB_UAF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("underflow; use-after-free");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_DEC_LEAK:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("decrement hit 0; leaking memory");
		break;
	default:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("unknown saturation event!?");
	}
}

Source code for filp_close:
int filp_close(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	int retval = 0;

	if (!file_count(filp)) {
		printk(KERN_ERR "VFS: Close: file count is 0\n");
		return 0;
	}

	if (filp->f_op->flush)
		retval = filp->f_op->flush(filp, id);

	if (likely(!(filp->f_mode & FMODE_PATH))) {
		dnotify_flush(filp, id);
		locks_remove_posix(filp, id);
	}
	fput(filp);
	return retval;
}
Source code for dnotify_flush:
void dnotify_flush(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	struct fsnotify_mark *fsn_mark;
	struct dnotify_mark *dn_mark;
	struct dnotify_struct *dn;
	struct dnotify_struct **prev;
	struct inode *inode;
	bool free = false;

	inode = file_inode(filp);
	if (!S_ISDIR(inode->i_mode))
		return;

	fsn_mark = fsnotify_find_mark(&inode->i_fsnotify_marks, dnotify_group);
	if (!fsn_mark)
		return;
	dn_mark = container_of(fsn_mark, struct dnotify_mark, fsn_mark);

	fsnotify_group_lock(dnotify_group);

	spin_lock(&fsn_mark->lock);
	prev = &dn_mark->dn;
	while ((dn = *prev) != NULL) {
		if ((dn->dn_owner == id) && (dn->dn_filp == filp)) {
			*prev = dn->dn_next;
			kmem_cache_free(dnotify_struct_cache, dn);
			dnotify_recalc_inode_mask(fsn_mark);
			break;
		}
		prev = &dn->dn_next;
	}

	spin_unlock(&fsn_mark->lock);

	/* nothing else could have found us thanks to the dnotify_groups
	   mark_mutex */
	if (dn_mark->dn == NULL) {
		fsnotify_detach_mark(fsn_mark);
		free = true;
	}

	fsnotify_group_unlock(dnotify_group);

	if (free)
		fsnotify_free_mark(fsn_mark);
	fsnotify_put_mark(fsn_mark);
}

Source code for __x64_sys_close:
NoneSource code for fsnotify_find_mark:
struct fsnotify_mark *fsnotify_find_mark(fsnotify_connp_t *connp,
					 struct fsnotify_group *group)
{
	struct fsnotify_mark_connector *conn;
	struct fsnotify_mark *mark;

	conn = fsnotify_grab_connector(connp);
	if (!conn)
		return NULL;

	hlist_for_each_entry(mark, &conn->list, obj_list) {
		if (mark->group == group &&
		    (mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED)) {
			fsnotify_get_mark(mark);
			spin_unlock(&conn->lock);
			return mark;
		}
	}
	spin_unlock(&conn->lock);
	return NULL;
}
Source code for fput:
void fput(struct file *file)
{
	if (atomic_long_dec_and_test(&file->f_count)) {
		struct task_struct *task = current;

		if (likely(!in_interrupt() && !(task->flags & PF_KTHREAD))) {
			init_task_work(&file->f_rcuhead, ____fput);
			if (!task_work_add(task, &file->f_rcuhead, TWA_RESUME))
				return;
			/*
			 */
		}

		if (llist_add(&file->f_llist, &delayed_fput_list))
			schedule_delayed_work(&delayed_fput_work, 1);
	}
}

Source code for llist_add_batch:
bool llist_add_batch(struct llist_node *new_first, struct llist_node *new_last,
		     struct llist_head *head)
{
	struct llist_node *first;

	do {
		new_last->next = first = READ_ONCE(head->first);
	} while (!try_cmpxchg(&head->first, &first, new_first));

	return !first;
}

Source code for queue_delayed_work_on:
bool queue_delayed_work_on(int cpu, struct workqueue_struct *wq,
			   struct delayed_work *dwork, unsigned long delay)
{
	struct work_struct *work = &dwork->work;
	bool ret = false;
	unsigned long flags;

	/* read the comment in __queue_work() */
	local_irq_save(flags);

	if (!test_and_set_bit(WORK_STRUCT_PENDING_BIT, work_data_bits(work))) {
		__queue_delayed_work(cpu, wq, dwork, delay);
		ret = true;
	}

	local_irq_restore(flags);
	return ret;
}

Source code for fsnotify_detach_mark:
void fsnotify_detach_mark(struct fsnotify_mark *mark)
{
	fsnotify_group_assert_locked(mark->group);
	WARN_ON_ONCE(!srcu_read_lock_held(&fsnotify_mark_srcu) &&
		     refcount_read(&mark->refcnt) < 1 +
			!!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED));

	spin_lock(&mark->lock);
	/* something else already called this function on this mark */
	if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED)) {
		spin_unlock(&mark->lock);
		return;
	}
	mark->flags &= ~FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED;
	list_del_init(&mark->g_list);
	spin_unlock(&mark->lock);

	/* Drop mark reference acquired in fsnotify_add_mark_locked() */
	fsnotify_put_mark(mark);
}

Source code for fsnotify_free_mark:
void fsnotify_free_mark(struct fsnotify_mark *mark)
{
	struct fsnotify_group *group = mark->group;

	spin_lock(&mark->lock);
	/* something else already called this function on this mark */
	if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ALIVE)) {
		spin_unlock(&mark->lock);
		return;
	}
	mark->flags &= ~FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ALIVE;
	spin_unlock(&mark->lock);

	/*
	 */
	if (group->ops->freeing_mark)
		group->ops->freeing_mark(mark, group);
}

Source code for fsnotify_recalc_mask:
void fsnotify_recalc_mask(struct fsnotify_mark_connector *conn)
{
	if (!conn)
		return;

	spin_lock(&conn->lock);
	__fsnotify_recalc_mask(conn);
	spin_unlock(&conn->lock);
	if (conn->type == FSNOTIFY_OBJ_TYPE_INODE)
		__fsnotify_update_child_dentry_flags(
					fsnotify_conn_inode(conn));
}

Source code for filp_close:
int filp_close(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	int retval = 0;

	if (!file_count(filp)) {
		printk(KERN_ERR "VFS: Close: file count is 0\n");
		return 0;
	}

	if (filp->f_op->flush)
		retval = filp->f_op->flush(filp, id);

	if (likely(!(filp->f_mode & FMODE_PATH))) {
		dnotify_flush(filp, id);
		locks_remove_posix(filp, id);
	}
	fput(filp);
	return retval;
}
Source code for dnotify_flush:
void dnotify_flush(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	struct fsnotify_mark *fsn_mark;
	struct dnotify_mark *dn_mark;
	struct dnotify_struct *dn;
	struct dnotify_struct **prev;
	struct inode *inode;
	bool free = false;

	inode = file_inode(filp);
	if (!S_ISDIR(inode->i_mode))
		return;

	fsn_mark = fsnotify_find_mark(&inode->i_fsnotify_marks, dnotify_group);
	if (!fsn_mark)
		return;
	dn_mark = container_of(fsn_mark, struct dnotify_mark, fsn_mark);

	fsnotify_group_lock(dnotify_group);

	spin_lock(&fsn_mark->lock);
	prev = &dn_mark->dn;
	while ((dn = *prev) != NULL) {
		if ((dn->dn_owner == id) && (dn->dn_filp == filp)) {
			*prev = dn->dn_next;
			kmem_cache_free(dnotify_struct_cache, dn);
			dnotify_recalc_inode_mask(fsn_mark);
			break;
		}
		prev = &dn->dn_next;
	}

	spin_unlock(&fsn_mark->lock);

	/* nothing else could have found us thanks to the dnotify_groups
	   mark_mutex */
	if (dn_mark->dn == NULL) {
		fsnotify_detach_mark(fsn_mark);
		free = true;
	}

	fsnotify_group_unlock(dnotify_group);

	if (free)
		fsnotify_free_mark(fsn_mark);
	fsnotify_put_mark(fsn_mark);
}

struct fsnotify_mark *fsnotify_find_mark(fsnotify_connp_t *connp,
					 struct fsnotify_group *group)
{
	struct fsnotify_mark_connector *conn;
	struct fsnotify_mark *mark;

	conn = fsnotify_grab_connector(connp);
	if (!conn)
		return NULL;

	hlist_for_each_entry(mark, &conn->list, obj_list) {
		if (mark->group == group &&
		    (mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED)) {
			fsnotify_get_mark(mark);
			spin_unlock(&conn->lock);
			return mark;
		}
	}
	spin_unlock(&conn->lock);
	return NULL;
}

static int mqueue_flush_file(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	struct mqueue_inode_info *info = MQUEUE_I(file_inode(filp));

	spin_lock(&info->lock);
	if (task_tgid(current) == info->notify_owner)
		remove_notification(info);

	spin_unlock(&info->lock);
	return 0;
}

bool queue_delayed_work_on(int cpu, struct workqueue_struct *wq,
			   struct delayed_work *dwork, unsigned long delay)
{
	struct work_struct *work = &dwork->work;
	bool ret = false;
	unsigned long flags;

	/* read the comment in __queue_work() */
	local_irq_save(flags);

	if (!test_and_set_bit(WORK_STRUCT_PENDING_BIT, work_data_bits(work))) {
		__queue_delayed_work(cpu, wq, dwork, delay);
		ret = true;
	}

	local_irq_restore(flags);
	return ret;
}

		     refcount_read(&mark->refcnt) < 1 +
			!!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED));

	spin_unlock(&mark->lock);

Source code for __queue_delayed_work:
static void __queue_delayed_work(int cpu, struct workqueue_struct *wq,
				struct delayed_work *dwork, unsigned long delay)
{
	struct timer_list *timer = &dwork->timer;
	struct work_struct *work = &dwork->work;

	WARN_ON_ONCE(!wq);
	WARN_ON_ONCE(timer->function != delayed_work_timer_fn);
	WARN_ON_ONCE(timer_pending(timer));
	WARN_ON_ONCE(!list_empty(&work->entry));

	/*
	 */
	if (!delay) {
		__queue_work(cpu, wq, &dwork->work);
		return;
	}

	dwork->wq = wq;
	dwork->cpu = cpu;
	timer->expires = jiffies + delay;

	if (unlikely(cpu != WORK_CPU_UNBOUND))
		add_timer_on(timer, cpu);
	else
		add_timer(timer);
}

Source code for filp_close:
int filp_close(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	int retval = 0;

	if (!file_count(filp)) {
		printk(KERN_ERR "VFS: Close: file count is 0\n");
		return 0;
	}

	if (filp->f_op->flush)
		retval = filp->f_op->flush(filp, id);

	if (likely(!(filp->f_mode & FMODE_PATH))) {
		dnotify_flush(filp, id);
		locks_remove_posix(filp, id);
	}
	fput(filp);
	return retval;
}
Source code for dnotify_flush:
void dnotify_flush(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	struct fsnotify_mark *fsn_mark;
	struct dnotify_mark *dn_mark;
	struct dnotify_struct *dn;
	struct dnotify_struct **prev;
	struct inode *inode;
	bool free = false;

	inode = file_inode(filp);
	if (!S_ISDIR(inode->i_mode))
		return;

	fsn_mark = fsnotify_find_mark(&inode->i_fsnotify_marks, dnotify_group);
	if (!fsn_mark)
		return;
	dn_mark = container_of(fsn_mark, struct dnotify_mark, fsn_mark);

	fsnotify_group_lock(dnotify_group);

	spin_lock(&fsn_mark->lock);
	prev = &dn_mark->dn;
	while ((dn = *prev) != NULL) {
		if ((dn->dn_owner == id) && (dn->dn_filp == filp)) {
			*prev = dn->dn_next;
			kmem_cache_free(dnotify_struct_cache, dn);
			dnotify_recalc_inode_mask(fsn_mark);
			break;
		}
		prev = &dn->dn_next;
	}

	spin_unlock(&fsn_mark->lock);

	/* nothing else could have found us thanks to the dnotify_groups
	   mark_mutex */
	if (dn_mark->dn == NULL) {
		fsnotify_detach_mark(fsn_mark);
		free = true;
	}

	fsnotify_group_unlock(dnotify_group);

	if (free)
		fsnotify_free_mark(fsn_mark);
	fsnotify_put_mark(fsn_mark);
}

Source code for __fsnotify_recalc_mask:
static void *__fsnotify_recalc_mask(struct fsnotify_mark_connector *conn)
{
	u32 new_mask = 0;
	bool want_iref = false;
	struct fsnotify_mark *mark;

	assert_spin_locked(&conn->lock);
	/* We can get detached connector here when inode is getting unlinked. */
	if (!fsnotify_valid_obj_type(conn->type))
		return NULL;
	hlist_for_each_entry(mark, &conn->list, obj_list) {
		if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED))
			continue;
		new_mask |= fsnotify_calc_mask(mark);
		if (conn->type == FSNOTIFY_OBJ_TYPE_INODE &&
		    !(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_NO_IREF))
			want_iref = true;
	}
	*fsnotify_conn_mask_p(conn) = new_mask;

	return fsnotify_update_iref(conn, want_iref);
}

Source code for __fsnotify_update_child_dentry_flags:
void __fsnotify_update_child_dentry_flags(struct inode *inode)
{
	struct dentry *alias;
	int watched;

	if (!S_ISDIR(inode->i_mode))
		return;

	/* determine if the children should tell inode about their events */
	watched = fsnotify_inode_watches_children(inode);

	spin_lock(&inode->i_lock);
	/* run all of the dentries associated with this inode.  Since this is a
	 * directory, there damn well better only be one item on this list */
	hlist_for_each_entry(alias, &inode->i_dentry, d_u.d_alias) {
		struct dentry *child;

		/* run all of the children of the original inode and fix their
		 * original inode) */
		spin_lock(&alias->d_lock);
		list_for_each_entry(child, &alias->d_subdirs, d_child) {
			if (!child->d_inode)
				continue;

			spin_lock_nested(&child->d_lock, DENTRY_D_LOCK_NESTED);
			if (watched)
				child->d_flags |= DCACHE_FSNOTIFY_PARENT_WATCHED;
			else
				child->d_flags &= ~DCACHE_FSNOTIFY_PARENT_WATCHED;
			spin_unlock(&child->d_lock);
		}
		spin_unlock(&alias->d_lock);
	}
	spin_unlock(&inode->i_lock);
}

Source code for filp_close:
int filp_close(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	int retval = 0;

	if (!file_count(filp)) {
		printk(KERN_ERR "VFS: Close: file count is 0\n");
		return 0;
	}

	if (filp->f_op->flush)
		retval = filp->f_op->flush(filp, id);

	if (likely(!(filp->f_mode & FMODE_PATH))) {
		dnotify_flush(filp, id);
		locks_remove_posix(filp, id);
	}
	fput(filp);
	return retval;
}
Source code for dnotify_flush:
void dnotify_flush(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	struct fsnotify_mark *fsn_mark;
	struct dnotify_mark *dn_mark;
	struct dnotify_struct *dn;
	struct dnotify_struct **prev;
	struct inode *inode;
	bool free = false;

	inode = file_inode(filp);
	if (!S_ISDIR(inode->i_mode))
		return;

	fsn_mark = fsnotify_find_mark(&inode->i_fsnotify_marks, dnotify_group);
	if (!fsn_mark)
		return;
	dn_mark = container_of(fsn_mark, struct dnotify_mark, fsn_mark);

	fsnotify_group_lock(dnotify_group);

	spin_lock(&fsn_mark->lock);
	prev = &dn_mark->dn;
	while ((dn = *prev) != NULL) {
		if ((dn->dn_owner == id) && (dn->dn_filp == filp)) {
			*prev = dn->dn_next;
			kmem_cache_free(dnotify_struct_cache, dn);
			dnotify_recalc_inode_mask(fsn_mark);
			break;
		}
		prev = &dn->dn_next;
	}

	spin_unlock(&fsn_mark->lock);

	/* nothing else could have found us thanks to the dnotify_groups
	   mark_mutex */
	if (dn_mark->dn == NULL) {
		fsnotify_detach_mark(fsn_mark);
		free = true;
	}

	fsnotify_group_unlock(dnotify_group);

	if (free)
		fsnotify_free_mark(fsn_mark);
	fsnotify_put_mark(fsn_mark);
}

Source code for __x64_sys_close:
NoneSource code for fsnotify_find_mark:
struct fsnotify_mark *fsnotify_find_mark(fsnotify_connp_t *connp,
					 struct fsnotify_group *group)
{
	struct fsnotify_mark_connector *conn;
	struct fsnotify_mark *mark;

	conn = fsnotify_grab_connector(connp);
	if (!conn)
		return NULL;

	hlist_for_each_entry(mark, &conn->list, obj_list) {
		if (mark->group == group &&
		    (mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED)) {
			fsnotify_get_mark(mark);
			spin_unlock(&conn->lock);
			return mark;
		}
	}
	spin_unlock(&conn->lock);
	return NULL;
}
Source code for fput:
void fput(struct file *file)
{
	if (atomic_long_dec_and_test(&file->f_count)) {
		struct task_struct *task = current;

		if (likely(!in_interrupt() && !(task->flags & PF_KTHREAD))) {
			init_task_work(&file->f_rcuhead, ____fput);
			if (!task_work_add(task, &file->f_rcuhead, TWA_RESUME))
				return;
			/*
			 */
		}

		if (llist_add(&file->f_llist, &delayed_fput_list))
			schedule_delayed_work(&delayed_fput_work, 1);
	}
}
Source code for fsnotify_free_mark:
void fsnotify_free_mark(struct fsnotify_mark *mark)
{
	struct fsnotify_group *group = mark->group;

	spin_lock(&mark->lock);
	/* something else already called this function on this mark */
	if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ALIVE)) {
		spin_unlock(&mark->lock);
		return;
	}
	mark->flags &= ~FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ALIVE;
	spin_unlock(&mark->lock);

	/*
	 */
	if (group->ops->freeing_mark)
		group->ops->freeing_mark(mark, group);
}
Source code for fsnotify_recalc_mask:
void fsnotify_recalc_mask(struct fsnotify_mark_connector *conn)
{
	if (!conn)
		return;

	spin_lock(&conn->lock);
	__fsnotify_recalc_mask(conn);
	spin_unlock(&conn->lock);
	if (conn->type == FSNOTIFY_OBJ_TYPE_INODE)
		__fsnotify_update_child_dentry_flags(
					fsnotify_conn_inode(conn));
}
Source code for mqueue_flush_file:
static int mqueue_flush_file(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	struct mqueue_inode_info *info = MQUEUE_I(file_inode(filp));

	spin_lock(&info->lock);
	if (task_tgid(current) == info->notify_owner)
		remove_notification(info);

	spin_unlock(&info->lock);
	return 0;
}

NoneSource code for queue_delayed_work_on:
bool queue_delayed_work_on(int cpu, struct workqueue_struct *wq,
			   struct delayed_work *dwork, unsigned long delay)
{
	struct work_struct *work = &dwork->work;
	bool ret = false;
	unsigned long flags;

	/* read the comment in __queue_work() */
	local_irq_save(flags);

	if (!test_and_set_bit(WORK_STRUCT_PENDING_BIT, work_data_bits(work))) {
		__queue_delayed_work(cpu, wq, dwork, delay);
		ret = true;
	}

	local_irq_restore(flags);
	return ret;
}
Source code for refcount_warn_saturate:
void refcount_warn_saturate(refcount_t *r, enum refcount_saturation_type t)
{
	refcount_set(r, REFCOUNT_SATURATED);

	switch (t) {
	case REFCOUNT_ADD_NOT_ZERO_OVF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("saturated; leaking memory");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_ADD_OVF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("saturated; leaking memory");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_ADD_UAF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("addition on 0; use-after-free");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_SUB_UAF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("underflow; use-after-free");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_DEC_LEAK:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("decrement hit 0; leaking memory");
		break;
	default:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("unknown saturation event!?");
	}
}
Source code for nfs_file_flush:
NoneSource code for fsnotify_detach_mark:
void fsnotify_detach_mark(struct fsnotify_mark *mark)
{
	fsnotify_group_assert_locked(mark->group);
	WARN_ON_ONCE(!srcu_read_lock_held(&fsnotify_mark_srcu) &&
		     refcount_read(&mark->refcnt) < 1 +
			!!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED));

	spin_lock(&mark->lock);
	/* something else already called this function on this mark */
	if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED)) {
		spin_unlock(&mark->lock);
		return;
	}
	mark->flags &= ~FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED;
	list_del_init(&mark->g_list);
	spin_unlock(&mark->lock);

	/* Drop mark reference acquired in fsnotify_add_mark_locked() */
	fsnotify_put_mark(mark);
}

🟢🟢🟢RESPONSE🟢🟢🟢: The function `fsnotify_recalc_mask` checks if the connector's type is `FSNOTIFY_OBJ_TYPE_INODE`. If so, it calls `__fsnotify_update_child_dentry_flags` on the associated inode. In the provided execution path, `dnotify_recalc_inode_mask` is invoked during `dnotify_flush`, which recalculates inode-specific notifications. This implies the connector here is of inode type. Thus, `fsnotify_recalc_mask` would trigger `__fsnotify_update_child_dentry_flags` for directory inodes.

🟢🟢🟢RESPONSE🟢🟢🟢: The `fsnotify_free_mark` function checks if the group's operations (`group->ops`) include a `freeing_mark` callback. In the provided code, `inotify_freeing_mark` is explicitly defined as a handler for freeing marks in inotify. For this to execute, the `group` passed to `fsnotify_free_mark` must be an inotify group whose `ops` structure includes `freeing_mark` set to `inotify_freeing_mark`. Since the code shows `fsnotify_free_mark` is called during `dnotify_flush` (which uses `dnotify_group`), but the question focuses on inotify, the answer hinges on whether inotify's group configuration includes this callback. In inotify's implementation, this is indeed the case.

Source code for errseq_check:
int errseq_check(errseq_t *eseq, errseq_t since)
{
	errseq_t cur = READ_ONCE(*eseq);

	if (likely(cur == since))
		return 0;
	return -(cur & MAX_ERRNO);
}

void fsnotify_detach_mark(struct fsnotify_mark *mark)
{
	fsnotify_group_assert_locked(mark->group);
	WARN_ON_ONCE(!srcu_read_lock_held(&fsnotify_mark_srcu) &&
		     refcount_read(&mark->refcnt) < 1 +
			!!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED));

	spin_lock(&mark->lock);
	/* something else already called this function on this mark */
	if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED)) {
		spin_unlock(&mark->lock);
		return;
	}
	mark->flags &= ~FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED;
	list_del_init(&mark->g_list);
	spin_unlock(&mark->lock);

	/* Drop mark reference acquired in fsnotify_add_mark_locked() */
	fsnotify_put_mark(mark);
}

Source code for errseq_sample:
errseq_t errseq_sample(errseq_t *eseq)
{
	errseq_t old = READ_ONCE(*eseq);

	/* If nobody has seen this error yet, then we can be the first. */
	if (!(old & ERRSEQ_SEEN))
		old = 0;
	return old;
}

Source code for filp_close:
int filp_close(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	int retval = 0;

	if (!file_count(filp)) {
		printk(KERN_ERR "VFS: Close: file count is 0\n");
		return 0;
	}

	if (filp->f_op->flush)
		retval = filp->f_op->flush(filp, id);

	if (likely(!(filp->f_mode & FMODE_PATH))) {
		dnotify_flush(filp, id);
		locks_remove_posix(filp, id);
	}
	fput(filp);
	return retval;
}
Source code for dnotify_flush:
void dnotify_flush(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	struct fsnotify_mark *fsn_mark;
	struct dnotify_mark *dn_mark;
	struct dnotify_struct *dn;
	struct dnotify_struct **prev;
	struct inode *inode;
	bool free = false;

	inode = file_inode(filp);
	if (!S_ISDIR(inode->i_mode))
		return;

	fsn_mark = fsnotify_find_mark(&inode->i_fsnotify_marks, dnotify_group);
	if (!fsn_mark)
		return;
	dn_mark = container_of(fsn_mark, struct dnotify_mark, fsn_mark);

	fsnotify_group_lock(dnotify_group);

	spin_lock(&fsn_mark->lock);
	prev = &dn_mark->dn;
	while ((dn = *prev) != NULL) {
		if ((dn->dn_owner == id) && (dn->dn_filp == filp)) {
			*prev = dn->dn_next;
			kmem_cache_free(dnotify_struct_cache, dn);
			dnotify_recalc_inode_mask(fsn_mark);
			break;
		}
		prev = &dn->dn_next;
	}

	spin_unlock(&fsn_mark->lock);

	/* nothing else could have found us thanks to the dnotify_groups
	   mark_mutex */
	if (dn_mark->dn == NULL) {
		fsnotify_detach_mark(fsn_mark);
		free = true;
	}

	fsnotify_group_unlock(dnotify_group);

	if (free)
		fsnotify_free_mark(fsn_mark);
	fsnotify_put_mark(fsn_mark);
}

Source code for __x64_sys_close:
NoneSource code for fsnotify_find_mark:
struct fsnotify_mark *fsnotify_find_mark(fsnotify_connp_t *connp,
					 struct fsnotify_group *group)
{
	struct fsnotify_mark_connector *conn;
	struct fsnotify_mark *mark;

	conn = fsnotify_grab_connector(connp);
	if (!conn)
		return NULL;

	hlist_for_each_entry(mark, &conn->list, obj_list) {
		if (mark->group == group &&
		    (mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED)) {
			fsnotify_get_mark(mark);
			spin_unlock(&conn->lock);
			return mark;
		}
	}
	spin_unlock(&conn->lock);
	return NULL;
}
Source code for fput:
void fput(struct file *file)
{
	if (atomic_long_dec_and_test(&file->f_count)) {
		struct task_struct *task = current;

		if (likely(!in_interrupt() && !(task->flags & PF_KTHREAD))) {
			init_task_work(&file->f_rcuhead, ____fput);
			if (!task_work_add(task, &file->f_rcuhead, TWA_RESUME))
				return;
			/*
			 */
		}

		if (llist_add(&file->f_llist, &delayed_fput_list))
			schedule_delayed_work(&delayed_fput_work, 1);
	}
}
Source code for fsnotify_free_mark:
void fsnotify_free_mark(struct fsnotify_mark *mark)
{
	struct fsnotify_group *group = mark->group;

	spin_lock(&mark->lock);
	/* something else already called this function on this mark */
	if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ALIVE)) {
		spin_unlock(&mark->lock);
		return;
	}
	mark->flags &= ~FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ALIVE;
	spin_unlock(&mark->lock);

	/*
	 */
	if (group->ops->freeing_mark)
		group->ops->freeing_mark(mark, group);
}
Source code for fsnotify_recalc_mask:
void fsnotify_recalc_mask(struct fsnotify_mark_connector *conn)
{
	if (!conn)
		return;

	spin_lock(&conn->lock);
	__fsnotify_recalc_mask(conn);
	spin_unlock(&conn->lock);
	if (conn->type == FSNOTIFY_OBJ_TYPE_INODE)
		__fsnotify_update_child_dentry_flags(
					fsnotify_conn_inode(conn));
}

Source code for nfs_wb_all:
int nfs_wb_all(struct inode *inode)
{
	int ret;

	trace_nfs_writeback_inode_enter(inode);

	ret = filemap_write_and_wait(inode->i_mapping);
	if (ret)
		goto out;
	ret = nfs_commit_inode(inode, FLUSH_SYNC);
	if (ret < 0)
		goto out;
	pnfs_sync_inode(inode, true);
	ret = 0;

out:
	trace_nfs_writeback_inode_exit(inode, ret);
	return ret;
}

struct fsnotify_mark *fsnotify_find_mark(fsnotify_connp_t *connp,
					 struct fsnotify_group *group)
{

	struct fsnotify_mark *mark;

	conn = fsnotify_grab_connector(connp);
	if (!conn)
		return NULL;

	return NULL;
}

static int mqueue_flush_file(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)

void fsnotify_detach_mark(struct fsnotify_mark *mark)
{

		     refcount_read(&mark->refcnt) < 1 +
			!!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED));

		spin_unlock(&mark->lock);
		return;

	mark->flags &= ~FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED;
	list_del_init(&mark->g_list);
	spin_unlock(&mark->lock);

	/* Drop mark reference acquired in fsnotify_add_mark_locked() */
	fsnotify_put_mark(mark);
}

Source code for nfs4_delegation_flush_on_close:
bool nfs4_delegation_flush_on_close(const struct inode *inode)
{
	struct nfs_inode *nfsi = NFS_I(inode);
	struct nfs_delegation *delegation;
	bool ret = true;

	rcu_read_lock();
	delegation = rcu_dereference(nfsi->delegation);
	if (delegation == NULL || !(delegation->type & FMODE_WRITE))
		goto out;
	if (atomic_long_read(&nfsi->nrequests) < delegation->pagemod_limit)
		ret = false;
out:
	rcu_read_unlock();
	return ret;
}

Source code for filp_close:
int filp_close(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	int retval = 0;

	if (!file_count(filp)) {
		printk(KERN_ERR "VFS: Close: file count is 0\n");
		return 0;
	}

	if (filp->f_op->flush)
		retval = filp->f_op->flush(filp, id);

	if (likely(!(filp->f_mode & FMODE_PATH))) {
		dnotify_flush(filp, id);
		locks_remove_posix(filp, id);
	}
	fput(filp);
	return retval;
}
Source code for dnotify_flush:
void dnotify_flush(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	struct fsnotify_mark *fsn_mark;
	struct dnotify_mark *dn_mark;
	struct dnotify_struct *dn;
	struct dnotify_struct **prev;
	struct inode *inode;
	bool free = false;

	inode = file_inode(filp);
	if (!S_ISDIR(inode->i_mode))
		return;

	fsn_mark = fsnotify_find_mark(&inode->i_fsnotify_marks, dnotify_group);
	if (!fsn_mark)
		return;
	dn_mark = container_of(fsn_mark, struct dnotify_mark, fsn_mark);

	fsnotify_group_lock(dnotify_group);

	spin_lock(&fsn_mark->lock);
	prev = &dn_mark->dn;
	while ((dn = *prev) != NULL) {
		if ((dn->dn_owner == id) && (dn->dn_filp == filp)) {
			*prev = dn->dn_next;
			kmem_cache_free(dnotify_struct_cache, dn);
			dnotify_recalc_inode_mask(fsn_mark);
			break;
		}
		prev = &dn->dn_next;
	}

	spin_unlock(&fsn_mark->lock);

	/* nothing else could have found us thanks to the dnotify_groups
	   mark_mutex */
	if (dn_mark->dn == NULL) {
		fsnotify_detach_mark(fsn_mark);
		free = true;
	}

	fsnotify_group_unlock(dnotify_group);

	if (free)
		fsnotify_free_mark(fsn_mark);
	fsnotify_put_mark(fsn_mark);
}

	if (!pid)
		return;

	ns = pid->numbers[pid->level].ns;
	if (refcount_dec_and_test(&pid->count)) {

		put_pid_ns(ns);
	}
}

Source code for dnotify_flush:
void dnotify_flush(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	struct fsnotify_mark *fsn_mark;
	struct dnotify_mark *dn_mark;
	struct dnotify_struct *dn;
	struct dnotify_struct **prev;
	struct inode *inode;
	bool free = false;

	inode = file_inode(filp);
	if (!S_ISDIR(inode->i_mode))
		return;

	fsn_mark = fsnotify_find_mark(&inode->i_fsnotify_marks, dnotify_group);
	if (!fsn_mark)
		return;
	dn_mark = container_of(fsn_mark, struct dnotify_mark, fsn_mark);

	fsnotify_group_lock(dnotify_group);

	spin_lock(&fsn_mark->lock);
	prev = &dn_mark->dn;
	while ((dn = *prev) != NULL) {
		if ((dn->dn_owner == id) && (dn->dn_filp == filp)) {
			*prev = dn->dn_next;
			kmem_cache_free(dnotify_struct_cache, dn);
			dnotify_recalc_inode_mask(fsn_mark);
			break;
		}
		prev = &dn->dn_next;
	}

	spin_unlock(&fsn_mark->lock);

	/* nothing else could have found us thanks to the dnotify_groups
	   mark_mutex */
	if (dn_mark->dn == NULL) {
		fsnotify_detach_mark(fsn_mark);
		free = true;
	}

	fsnotify_group_unlock(dnotify_group);

	if (free)
		fsnotify_free_mark(fsn_mark);
	fsnotify_put_mark(fsn_mark);
}

Source code for __queue_delayed_work:
static void __queue_delayed_work(int cpu, struct workqueue_struct *wq,
				struct delayed_work *dwork, unsigned long delay)
{
	struct timer_list *timer = &dwork->timer;
	struct work_struct *work = &dwork->work;

	WARN_ON_ONCE(!wq);
	WARN_ON_ONCE(timer->function != delayed_work_timer_fn);
	WARN_ON_ONCE(timer_pending(timer));
	WARN_ON_ONCE(!list_empty(&work->entry));

	/*
	 */
	if (!delay) {
		__queue_work(cpu, wq, &dwork->work);
		return;
	}

	dwork->wq = wq;
	dwork->cpu = cpu;
	timer->expires = jiffies + delay;

	if (unlikely(cpu != WORK_CPU_UNBOUND))
		add_timer_on(timer, cpu);
	else
		add_timer(timer);
}
Source code for nfs_wb_all:
int nfs_wb_all(struct inode *inode)
{
	int ret;

	trace_nfs_writeback_inode_enter(inode);

	ret = filemap_write_and_wait(inode->i_mapping);
	if (ret)
		goto out;
	ret = nfs_commit_inode(inode, FLUSH_SYNC);
	if (ret < 0)
		goto out;
	pnfs_sync_inode(inode, true);
	ret = 0;

out:
	trace_nfs_writeback_inode_exit(inode, ret);
	return ret;
}
Source code for nfs4_delegation_flush_on_close:
bool nfs4_delegation_flush_on_close(const struct inode *inode)
{
	struct nfs_inode *nfsi = NFS_I(inode);
	struct nfs_delegation *delegation;
	bool ret = true;

	rcu_read_lock();
	delegation = rcu_dereference(nfsi->delegation);
	if (delegation == NULL || !(delegation->type & FMODE_WRITE))
		goto out;
	if (atomic_long_read(&nfsi->nrequests) < delegation->pagemod_limit)
		ret = false;
out:
	rcu_read_unlock();
	return ret;
}
Source code for __fsnotify_update_child_dentry_flags:
void __fsnotify_update_child_dentry_flags(struct inode *inode)
{
	struct dentry *alias;
	int watched;

	if (!S_ISDIR(inode->i_mode))
		return;

	/* determine if the children should tell inode about their events */
	watched = fsnotify_inode_watches_children(inode);

	spin_lock(&inode->i_lock);
	/* run all of the dentries associated with this inode.  Since this is a
	 * directory, there damn well better only be one item on this list */
	hlist_for_each_entry(alias, &inode->i_dentry, d_u.d_alias) {
		struct dentry *child;

		/* run all of the children of the original inode and fix their
		 * original inode) */
		spin_lock(&alias->d_lock);
		list_for_each_entry(child, &alias->d_subdirs, d_child) {
			if (!child->d_inode)
				continue;

			spin_lock_nested(&child->d_lock, DENTRY_D_LOCK_NESTED);
			if (watched)
				child->d_flags |= DCACHE_FSNOTIFY_PARENT_WATCHED;
			else
				child->d_flags &= ~DCACHE_FSNOTIFY_PARENT_WATCHED;
			spin_unlock(&child->d_lock);
		}
		spin_unlock(&alias->d_lock);
	}
	spin_unlock(&inode->i_lock);
}
Source code for __fsnotify_recalc_mask:
static void *__fsnotify_recalc_mask(struct fsnotify_mark_connector *conn)
{
	u32 new_mask = 0;
	bool want_iref = false;
	struct fsnotify_mark *mark;

	assert_spin_locked(&conn->lock);
	/* We can get detached connector here when inode is getting unlinked. */
	if (!fsnotify_valid_obj_type(conn->type))
		return NULL;
	hlist_for_each_entry(mark, &conn->list, obj_list) {
		if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED))
			continue;
		new_mask |= fsnotify_calc_mask(mark);
		if (conn->type == FSNOTIFY_OBJ_TYPE_INODE &&
		    !(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_NO_IREF))
			want_iref = true;
	}
	*fsnotify_conn_mask_p(conn) = new_mask;

	return fsnotify_update_iref(conn, want_iref);
}

Source code for inotify_ignored_and_remove_idr:
void inotify_ignored_and_remove_idr(struct fsnotify_mark *fsn_mark,
				    struct fsnotify_group *group)
{
	struct inotify_inode_mark *i_mark;

	/* Queue ignore event for the watch */
	inotify_handle_inode_event(fsn_mark, FS_IN_IGNORED, NULL, NULL, NULL,
				   0);

	i_mark = container_of(fsn_mark, struct inotify_inode_mark, fsn_mark);
	/* remove this mark from the idr */
	inotify_remove_from_idr(group, i_mark);

	dec_inotify_watches(group->inotify_data.ucounts);
}

	if (likely(!(filp->f_mode & FMODE_PATH))) {
		dnotify_flush(filp, id);
		locks_remove_posix(filp, id);
	}
	fput(filp);
	return retval;
}
Source code for dnotify_flush:
void dnotify_flush(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	struct fsnotify_mark *fsn_mark;
	struct dnotify_mark *dn_mark;
	struct dnotify_struct *dn;
	struct dnotify_struct **prev;
	struct inode *inode;
	bool free = false;

	inode = file_inode(filp);
	if (!S_ISDIR(inode->i_mode))
		return;

	fsn_mark = fsnotify_find_mark(&inode->i_fsnotify_marks, dnotify_group);
	if (!fsn_mark)
		return;
	dn_mark = container_of(fsn_mark, struct dnotify_mark, fsn_mark);

	fsnotify_group_lock(dnotify_group);

	spin_lock(&fsn_mark->lock);
	prev = &dn_mark->dn;
	while ((dn = *prev) != NULL) {
		if ((dn->dn_owner == id) && (dn->dn_filp == filp)) {
			*prev = dn->dn_next;
			kmem_cache_free(dnotify_struct_cache, dn);
			dnotify_recalc_inode_mask(fsn_mark);
			break;
		}
		prev = &dn->dn_next;
	}

	spin_unlock(&fsn_mark->lock);

	/* nothing else could have found us thanks to the dnotify_groups
	   mark_mutex */
	if (dn_mark->dn == NULL) {
		fsnotify_detach_mark(fsn_mark);
		free = true;
	}

	fsnotify_group_unlock(dnotify_group);

	if (free)
		fsnotify_free_mark(fsn_mark);
	fsnotify_put_mark(fsn_mark);
}

struct fsnotify_mark *fsnotify_find_mark(fsnotify_connp_t *connp,
					 struct fsnotify_group *group)
{
	struct fsnotify_mark_connector *conn;
	struct fsnotify_mark *mark;

	conn = fsnotify_grab_connector(connp);
	if (!conn)
		return NULL;

	hlist_for_each_entry(mark, &conn->list, obj_list) {
		if (mark->group == group &&
		    (mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED)) {
			fsnotify_get_mark(mark);
			spin_unlock(&conn->lock);
			return mark;
		}
	}
	spin_unlock(&conn->lock);
	return NULL;
}
Source code for fput:
void fput(struct file *file)
{
	if (atomic_long_dec_and_test(&file->f_count)) {
		struct task_struct *task = current;

		if (likely(!in_interrupt() && !(task->flags & PF_KTHREAD))) {
			init_task_work(&file->f_rcuhead, ____fput);
			if (!task_work_add(task, &file->f_rcuhead, TWA_RESUME))
				return;
			/*
			 */
		}

		if (llist_add(&file->f_llist, &delayed_fput_list))
			schedule_delayed_work(&delayed_fput_work, 1);
	}
}
Source code for fsnotify_free_mark:
void fsnotify_free_mark(struct fsnotify_mark *mark)
{
	struct fsnotify_group *group = mark->group;

	spin_lock(&mark->lock);
	/* something else already called this function on this mark */
	if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ALIVE)) {
		spin_unlock(&mark->lock);
		return;
	}
	mark->flags &= ~FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ALIVE;
	spin_unlock(&mark->lock);

	/*
	 */
	if (group->ops->freeing_mark)
		group->ops->freeing_mark(mark, group);
}

		return;

	__fsnotify_recalc_mask(conn);
	spin_unlock(&conn->lock);
	if (conn->type == FSNOTIFY_OBJ_TYPE_INODE)
		__fsnotify_update_child_dentry_flags(
					fsnotify_conn_inode(conn));
}

bool queue_delayed_work_on(int cpu, struct workqueue_struct *wq,
			   struct delayed_work *dwork, unsigned long delay)
{
	struct work_struct *work = &dwork->work;
	bool ret = false;
	unsigned long flags;

	/* read the comment in __queue_work() */
	local_irq_save(flags);

	if (!test_and_set_bit(WORK_STRUCT_PENDING_BIT, work_data_bits(work))) {
		__queue_delayed_work(cpu, wq, dwork, delay);
		ret = true;
	}

	local_irq_restore(flags);
	return ret;
}
Source code for refcount_warn_saturate:
void refcount_warn_saturate(refcount_t *r, enum refcount_saturation_type t)
{
	refcount_set(r, REFCOUNT_SATURATED);

	switch (t) {
	case REFCOUNT_ADD_NOT_ZERO_OVF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("saturated; leaking memory");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_ADD_OVF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("saturated; leaking memory");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_ADD_UAF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("addition on 0; use-after-free");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_SUB_UAF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("underflow; use-after-free");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_DEC_LEAK:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("decrement hit 0; leaking memory");
		break;
	default:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("unknown saturation event!?");
	}
}

void fsnotify_detach_mark(struct fsnotify_mark *mark)
{
	fsnotify_group_assert_locked(mark->group);
	WARN_ON_ONCE(!srcu_read_lock_held(&fsnotify_mark_srcu) &&
		     refcount_read(&mark->refcnt) < 1 +
			!!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED));

	spin_lock(&mark->lock);
	/* something else already called this function on this mark */
	if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED)) {
		spin_unlock(&mark->lock);
		return;
	}
	mark->flags &= ~FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED;
	list_del_init(&mark->g_list);
	spin_unlock(&mark->lock);

	/* Drop mark reference acquired in fsnotify_add_mark_locked() */
	fsnotify_put_mark(mark);
}

Source code for __queue_delayed_work:
static void __queue_delayed_work(int cpu, struct workqueue_struct *wq,
				struct delayed_work *dwork, unsigned long delay)
{
	struct timer_list *timer = &dwork->timer;
	struct work_struct *work = &dwork->work;

	WARN_ON_ONCE(!wq);
	WARN_ON_ONCE(timer->function != delayed_work_timer_fn);
	WARN_ON_ONCE(timer_pending(timer));
	WARN_ON_ONCE(!list_empty(&work->entry));

	/*
	 */
	if (!delay) {
		__queue_work(cpu, wq, &dwork->work);
		return;
	}

	dwork->wq = wq;
	dwork->cpu = cpu;
	timer->expires = jiffies + delay;

	if (unlikely(cpu != WORK_CPU_UNBOUND))
		add_timer_on(timer, cpu);
	else
		add_timer(timer);
}
Source code for nfs_wb_all:
int nfs_wb_all(struct inode *inode)
{
	int ret;

	trace_nfs_writeback_inode_enter(inode);

	ret = filemap_write_and_wait(inode->i_mapping);
	if (ret)
		goto out;
	ret = nfs_commit_inode(inode, FLUSH_SYNC);
	if (ret < 0)
		goto out;
	pnfs_sync_inode(inode, true);
	ret = 0;

out:
	trace_nfs_writeback_inode_exit(inode, ret);
	return ret;
}
Source code for nfs4_delegation_flush_on_close:
bool nfs4_delegation_flush_on_close(const struct inode *inode)
{
	struct nfs_inode *nfsi = NFS_I(inode);
	struct nfs_delegation *delegation;
	bool ret = true;

	rcu_read_lock();
	delegation = rcu_dereference(nfsi->delegation);
	if (delegation == NULL || !(delegation->type & FMODE_WRITE))
		goto out;
	if (atomic_long_read(&nfsi->nrequests) < delegation->pagemod_limit)
		ret = false;
out:
	rcu_read_unlock();
	return ret;
}
Source code for __fsnotify_update_child_dentry_flags:
void __fsnotify_update_child_dentry_flags(struct inode *inode)
{
	struct dentry *alias;
	int watched;

	if (!S_ISDIR(inode->i_mode))
		return;

	/* determine if the children should tell inode about their events */
	watched = fsnotify_inode_watches_children(inode);

	spin_lock(&inode->i_lock);
	/* run all of the dentries associated with this inode.  Since this is a
	 * directory, there damn well better only be one item on this list */
	hlist_for_each_entry(alias, &inode->i_dentry, d_u.d_alias) {
		struct dentry *child;

		/* run all of the children of the original inode and fix their
		 * original inode) */
		spin_lock(&alias->d_lock);
		list_for_each_entry(child, &alias->d_subdirs, d_child) {
			if (!child->d_inode)
				continue;

			spin_lock_nested(&child->d_lock, DENTRY_D_LOCK_NESTED);
			if (watched)
				child->d_flags |= DCACHE_FSNOTIFY_PARENT_WATCHED;
			else
				child->d_flags &= ~DCACHE_FSNOTIFY_PARENT_WATCHED;
			spin_unlock(&child->d_lock);
		}
		spin_unlock(&alias->d_lock);
	}
	spin_unlock(&inode->i_lock);
}
Source code for __fsnotify_recalc_mask:
static void *__fsnotify_recalc_mask(struct fsnotify_mark_connector *conn)
{
	u32 new_mask = 0;
	bool want_iref = false;
	struct fsnotify_mark *mark;

	assert_spin_locked(&conn->lock);
	/* We can get detached connector here when inode is getting unlinked. */
	if (!fsnotify_valid_obj_type(conn->type))
		return NULL;
	hlist_for_each_entry(mark, &conn->list, obj_list) {
		if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED))
			continue;
		new_mask |= fsnotify_calc_mask(mark);
		if (conn->type == FSNOTIFY_OBJ_TYPE_INODE &&
		    !(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_NO_IREF))
			want_iref = true;
	}
	*fsnotify_conn_mask_p(conn) = new_mask;

	return fsnotify_update_iref(conn, want_iref);
}

Source code for __nfs_commit_inode:
static int __nfs_commit_inode(struct inode *inode, int how,
		struct writeback_control *wbc)
{
	LIST_HEAD(head);
	struct nfs_commit_info cinfo;
	int may_wait = how & FLUSH_SYNC;
	int ret, nscan;

	how &= ~FLUSH_SYNC;
	nfs_init_cinfo_from_inode(&cinfo, inode);
	nfs_commit_begin(cinfo.mds);
	for (;;) {
		ret = nscan = nfs_scan_commit(inode, &head, &cinfo);
		if (ret <= 0)
			break;
		ret = nfs_generic_commit_list(inode, &head, how, &cinfo);
		if (ret < 0)
			break;
		ret = 0;
		if (wbc && wbc->sync_mode == WB_SYNC_NONE) {
			if (nscan < wbc->nr_to_write)
				wbc->nr_to_write -= nscan;
			else
				wbc->nr_to_write = 0;
		}
		if (nscan < INT_MAX)
			break;
		cond_resched();
	}
	nfs_commit_end(cinfo.mds);
	if (ret || !may_wait)
		return ret;
	return wait_on_commit(cinfo.mds);
}

Source code for filp_close:
int filp_close(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	int retval = 0;

	if (!file_count(filp)) {
		printk(KERN_ERR "VFS: Close: file count is 0\n");
		return 0;
	}

	if (filp->f_op->flush)
		retval = filp->f_op->flush(filp, id);

	if (likely(!(filp->f_mode & FMODE_PATH))) {
		dnotify_flush(filp, id);
		locks_remove_posix(filp, id);
	}
	fput(filp);
	return retval;
}
Source code for dnotify_flush:
void dnotify_flush(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	struct fsnotify_mark *fsn_mark;
	struct dnotify_mark *dn_mark;
	struct dnotify_struct *dn;
	struct dnotify_struct **prev;
	struct inode *inode;
	bool free = false;

	inode = file_inode(filp);
	if (!S_ISDIR(inode->i_mode))
		return;

	fsn_mark = fsnotify_find_mark(&inode->i_fsnotify_marks, dnotify_group);
	if (!fsn_mark)
		return;
	dn_mark = container_of(fsn_mark, struct dnotify_mark, fsn_mark);

	fsnotify_group_lock(dnotify_group);

	spin_lock(&fsn_mark->lock);
	prev = &dn_mark->dn;
	while ((dn = *prev) != NULL) {
		if ((dn->dn_owner == id) && (dn->dn_filp == filp)) {
			*prev = dn->dn_next;
			kmem_cache_free(dnotify_struct_cache, dn);
			dnotify_recalc_inode_mask(fsn_mark);
			break;
		}
		prev = &dn->dn_next;
	}

	spin_unlock(&fsn_mark->lock);

	/* nothing else could have found us thanks to the dnotify_groups
	   mark_mutex */
	if (dn_mark->dn == NULL) {
		fsnotify_detach_mark(fsn_mark);
		free = true;
	}

	fsnotify_group_unlock(dnotify_group);

	if (free)
		fsnotify_free_mark(fsn_mark);
	fsnotify_put_mark(fsn_mark);
}

	struct nfs_delegation *delegation;

Source code for __fsnotify_update_child_dentry_flags:
void __fsnotify_update_child_dentry_flags(struct inode *inode)
{
	struct dentry *alias;
	int watched;

	if (!S_ISDIR(inode->i_mode))
		return;

	/* determine if the children should tell inode about their events */
	watched = fsnotify_inode_watches_children(inode);

	spin_lock(&inode->i_lock);
	/* run all of the dentries associated with this inode.  Since this is a
	 * directory, there damn well better only be one item on this list */
	hlist_for_each_entry(alias, &inode->i_dentry, d_u.d_alias) {
		struct dentry *child;

		/* run all of the children of the original inode and fix their
		 * original inode) */
		spin_lock(&alias->d_lock);
		list_for_each_entry(child, &alias->d_subdirs, d_child) {
			if (!child->d_inode)
				continue;

			spin_lock_nested(&child->d_lock, DENTRY_D_LOCK_NESTED);
			if (watched)
				child->d_flags |= DCACHE_FSNOTIFY_PARENT_WATCHED;
			else
				child->d_flags &= ~DCACHE_FSNOTIFY_PARENT_WATCHED;
			spin_unlock(&child->d_lock);
		}
		spin_unlock(&alias->d_lock);
	}
	spin_unlock(&inode->i_lock);
}
Source code for __fsnotify_recalc_mask:
static void *__fsnotify_recalc_mask(struct fsnotify_mark_connector *conn)
{
	u32 new_mask = 0;
	bool want_iref = false;
	struct fsnotify_mark *mark;

	assert_spin_locked(&conn->lock);
	/* We can get detached connector here when inode is getting unlinked. */
	if (!fsnotify_valid_obj_type(conn->type))
		return NULL;
	hlist_for_each_entry(mark, &conn->list, obj_list) {
		if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED))
			continue;
		new_mask |= fsnotify_calc_mask(mark);
		if (conn->type == FSNOTIFY_OBJ_TYPE_INODE &&
		    !(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_NO_IREF))
			want_iref = true;
	}
	*fsnotify_conn_mask_p(conn) = new_mask;

	return fsnotify_update_iref(conn, want_iref);
}

Source code for dnotify_flush:
void dnotify_flush(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	struct fsnotify_mark *fsn_mark;
	struct dnotify_mark *dn_mark;
	struct dnotify_struct *dn;
	struct dnotify_struct **prev;
	struct inode *inode;
	bool free = false;

	inode = file_inode(filp);
	if (!S_ISDIR(inode->i_mode))
		return;

	fsn_mark = fsnotify_find_mark(&inode->i_fsnotify_marks, dnotify_group);
	if (!fsn_mark)
		return;
	dn_mark = container_of(fsn_mark, struct dnotify_mark, fsn_mark);

	fsnotify_group_lock(dnotify_group);

	spin_lock(&fsn_mark->lock);
	prev = &dn_mark->dn;
	while ((dn = *prev) != NULL) {
		if ((dn->dn_owner == id) && (dn->dn_filp == filp)) {
			*prev = dn->dn_next;
			kmem_cache_free(dnotify_struct_cache, dn);
			dnotify_recalc_inode_mask(fsn_mark);
			break;
		}
		prev = &dn->dn_next;
	}

	spin_unlock(&fsn_mark->lock);

	/* nothing else could have found us thanks to the dnotify_groups
	   mark_mutex */
	if (dn_mark->dn == NULL) {
		fsnotify_detach_mark(fsn_mark);
		free = true;
	}

	fsnotify_group_unlock(dnotify_group);

	if (free)
		fsnotify_free_mark(fsn_mark);
	fsnotify_put_mark(fsn_mark);
}

struct fsnotify_mark *fsnotify_find_mark(fsnotify_connp_t *connp,

void fsnotify_free_mark(struct fsnotify_mark *mark)
{
	struct fsnotify_group *group = mark->group;

	spin_lock(&mark->lock);
	/* something else already called this function on this mark */
	if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ALIVE)) {
		spin_unlock(&mark->lock);
		return;
	}
	mark->flags &= ~FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ALIVE;
	spin_unlock(&mark->lock);

		group->ops->freeing_mark(mark, group);
}

Source code for refcount_warn_saturate:
void refcount_warn_saturate(refcount_t *r, enum refcount_saturation_type t)
{
	refcount_set(r, REFCOUNT_SATURATED);

	switch (t) {
	case REFCOUNT_ADD_NOT_ZERO_OVF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("saturated; leaking memory");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_ADD_OVF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("saturated; leaking memory");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_ADD_UAF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("addition on 0; use-after-free");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_SUB_UAF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("underflow; use-after-free");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_DEC_LEAK:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("decrement hit 0; leaking memory");
		break;
	default:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("unknown saturation event!?");
	}
}

void fsnotify_detach_mark(struct fsnotify_mark *mark)
{
	fsnotify_group_assert_locked(mark->group);
	WARN_ON_ONCE(!srcu_read_lock_held(&fsnotify_mark_srcu) &&
		     refcount_read(&mark->refcnt) < 1 +
			!!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED));

	spin_lock(&mark->lock);
	/* something else already called this function on this mark */
	if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED)) {
		spin_unlock(&mark->lock);
		return;
	}
	mark->flags &= ~FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED;
	list_del_init(&mark->g_list);
	spin_unlock(&mark->lock);

	/* Drop mark reference acquired in fsnotify_add_mark_locked() */
	fsnotify_put_mark(mark);
}

Source code for __queue_delayed_work:
static void __queue_delayed_work(int cpu, struct workqueue_struct *wq,
				struct delayed_work *dwork, unsigned long delay)
{
	struct timer_list *timer = &dwork->timer;
	struct work_struct *work = &dwork->work;

	WARN_ON_ONCE(!wq);
	WARN_ON_ONCE(timer->function != delayed_work_timer_fn);
	WARN_ON_ONCE(timer_pending(timer));
	WARN_ON_ONCE(!list_empty(&work->entry));

	/*
	 */
	if (!delay) {
		__queue_work(cpu, wq, &dwork->work);
		return;
	}

	dwork->wq = wq;
	dwork->cpu = cpu;
	timer->expires = jiffies + delay;

	if (unlikely(cpu != WORK_CPU_UNBOUND))
		add_timer_on(timer, cpu);
	else
		add_timer(timer);
}
Source code for nfs_wb_all:
int nfs_wb_all(struct inode *inode)
{
	int ret;

	trace_nfs_writeback_inode_enter(inode);

	ret = filemap_write_and_wait(inode->i_mapping);
	if (ret)
		goto out;
	ret = nfs_commit_inode(inode, FLUSH_SYNC);
	if (ret < 0)
		goto out;
	pnfs_sync_inode(inode, true);
	ret = 0;

out:
	trace_nfs_writeback_inode_exit(inode, ret);
	return ret;
}

	bool ret = false;
	unsigned long flags;

	/* read the comment in __queue_work() */
	local_irq_save(flags);

		__queue_delayed_work(cpu, wq, dwork, delay);
		ret = true;
	}

	local_irq_restore(flags);
	return ret;

void fsnotify_detach_mark(struct fsnotify_mark *mark)
{
	fsnotify_group_assert_locked(mark->group);
	WARN_ON_ONCE(!srcu_read_lock_held(&fsnotify_mark_srcu) &&
		     refcount_read(&mark->refcnt) < 1 +
			!!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED));

	spin_lock(&mark->lock);
	/* something else already called this function on this mark */
	if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED)) {
		spin_unlock(&mark->lock);
		return;
	}
	mark->flags &= ~FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED;
	list_del_init(&mark->g_list);
	spin_unlock(&mark->lock);

	/* Drop mark reference acquired in fsnotify_add_mark_locked() */
	fsnotify_put_mark(mark);
}

Source code for __queue_delayed_work:
static void __queue_delayed_work(int cpu, struct workqueue_struct *wq,
				struct delayed_work *dwork, unsigned long delay)
{
	struct timer_list *timer = &dwork->timer;
	struct work_struct *work = &dwork->work;

	WARN_ON_ONCE(!wq);
	WARN_ON_ONCE(timer->function != delayed_work_timer_fn);
	WARN_ON_ONCE(timer_pending(timer));
	WARN_ON_ONCE(!list_empty(&work->entry));

	/*
	 */
	if (!delay) {
		__queue_work(cpu, wq, &dwork->work);
		return;
	}

	dwork->wq = wq;
	dwork->cpu = cpu;
	timer->expires = jiffies + delay;

	if (unlikely(cpu != WORK_CPU_UNBOUND))
		add_timer_on(timer, cpu);
	else
		add_timer(timer);
}
Source code for nfs_wb_all:
int nfs_wb_all(struct inode *inode)
{
	int ret;

	trace_nfs_writeback_inode_enter(inode);

	ret = filemap_write_and_wait(inode->i_mapping);
	if (ret)
		goto out;
	ret = nfs_commit_inode(inode, FLUSH_SYNC);
	if (ret < 0)
		goto out;
	pnfs_sync_inode(inode, true);
	ret = 0;

out:
	trace_nfs_writeback_inode_exit(inode, ret);
	return ret;
}
Source code for nfs4_delegation_flush_on_close:
bool nfs4_delegation_flush_on_close(const struct inode *inode)
{
	struct nfs_inode *nfsi = NFS_I(inode);
	struct nfs_delegation *delegation;
	bool ret = true;

	rcu_read_lock();
	delegation = rcu_dereference(nfsi->delegation);
	if (delegation == NULL || !(delegation->type & FMODE_WRITE))
		goto out;
	if (atomic_long_read(&nfsi->nrequests) < delegation->pagemod_limit)
		ret = false;
out:
	rcu_read_unlock();
	return ret;
}
Source code for __fsnotify_update_child_dentry_flags:
void __fsnotify_update_child_dentry_flags(struct inode *inode)
{
	struct dentry *alias;
	int watched;

	if (!S_ISDIR(inode->i_mode))
		return;

	/* determine if the children should tell inode about their events */
	watched = fsnotify_inode_watches_children(inode);

	spin_lock(&inode->i_lock);
	/* run all of the dentries associated with this inode.  Since this is a
	 * directory, there damn well better only be one item on this list */
	hlist_for_each_entry(alias, &inode->i_dentry, d_u.d_alias) {
		struct dentry *child;

		/* run all of the children of the original inode and fix their
		 * original inode) */
		spin_lock(&alias->d_lock);
		list_for_each_entry(child, &alias->d_subdirs, d_child) {
			if (!child->d_inode)
				continue;

			spin_lock_nested(&child->d_lock, DENTRY_D_LOCK_NESTED);
			if (watched)
				child->d_flags |= DCACHE_FSNOTIFY_PARENT_WATCHED;
			else
				child->d_flags &= ~DCACHE_FSNOTIFY_PARENT_WATCHED;
			spin_unlock(&child->d_lock);
		}
		spin_unlock(&alias->d_lock);
	}
	spin_unlock(&inode->i_lock);
}
Source code for __fsnotify_recalc_mask:
static void *__fsnotify_recalc_mask(struct fsnotify_mark_connector *conn)
{
	u32 new_mask = 0;
	bool want_iref = false;
	struct fsnotify_mark *mark;

	assert_spin_locked(&conn->lock);
	/* We can get detached connector here when inode is getting unlinked. */
	if (!fsnotify_valid_obj_type(conn->type))
		return NULL;
	hlist_for_each_entry(mark, &conn->list, obj_list) {
		if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED))
			continue;
		new_mask |= fsnotify_calc_mask(mark);
		if (conn->type == FSNOTIFY_OBJ_TYPE_INODE &&
		    !(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_NO_IREF))
			want_iref = true;
	}
	*fsnotify_conn_mask_p(conn) = new_mask;

	return fsnotify_update_iref(conn, want_iref);
}
Source code for __nfs_commit_inode:
static int __nfs_commit_inode(struct inode *inode, int how,
		struct writeback_control *wbc)
{
	LIST_HEAD(head);
	struct nfs_commit_info cinfo;
	int may_wait = how & FLUSH_SYNC;
	int ret, nscan;

	how &= ~FLUSH_SYNC;
	nfs_init_cinfo_from_inode(&cinfo, inode);
	nfs_commit_begin(cinfo.mds);
	for (;;) {
		ret = nscan = nfs_scan_commit(inode, &head, &cinfo);
		if (ret <= 0)
			break;
		ret = nfs_generic_commit_list(inode, &head, how, &cinfo);
		if (ret < 0)
			break;
		ret = 0;
		if (wbc && wbc->sync_mode == WB_SYNC_NONE) {
			if (nscan < wbc->nr_to_write)
				wbc->nr_to_write -= nscan;
			else
				wbc->nr_to_write = 0;
		}
		if (nscan < INT_MAX)
			break;
		cond_resched();
	}
	nfs_commit_end(cinfo.mds);
	if (ret || !may_wait)
		return ret;
	return wait_on_commit(cinfo.mds);
}
Source code for inotify_ignored_and_remove_idr:
void inotify_ignored_and_remove_idr(struct fsnotify_mark *fsn_mark,
				    struct fsnotify_group *group)
{
	struct inotify_inode_mark *i_mark;

	/* Queue ignore event for the watch */
	inotify_handle_inode_event(fsn_mark, FS_IN_IGNORED, NULL, NULL, NULL,
				   0);

	i_mark = container_of(fsn_mark, struct inotify_inode_mark, fsn_mark);
	/* remove this mark from the idr */
	inotify_remove_from_idr(group, i_mark);

	dec_inotify_watches(group->inotify_data.ucounts);
}
Source code for put_pid_ns:
void put_pid_ns(struct pid_namespace *ns)
{
	struct pid_namespace *parent;

	while (ns != &init_pid_ns) {
		parent = ns->parent;
		if (!refcount_dec_and_test(&ns->ns.count))
			break;
		destroy_pid_namespace(ns);
		ns = parent;
	}
}

Source code for inotify_handle_inode_event:
int inotify_handle_inode_event(struct fsnotify_mark *inode_mark, u32 mask,
			       struct inode *inode, struct inode *dir,
			       const struct qstr *name, u32 cookie)
{
	struct inotify_inode_mark *i_mark;
	struct inotify_event_info *event;
	struct fsnotify_event *fsn_event;
	struct fsnotify_group *group = inode_mark->group;
	int ret;
	int len = 0;
	int alloc_len = sizeof(struct inotify_event_info);
	struct mem_cgroup *old_memcg;

	if (name) {
		len = name->len;
		alloc_len += len + 1;
	}

	pr_debug("%s: group=%p mark=%p mask=%x\n", __func__, group, inode_mark,
		 mask);

	i_mark = container_of(inode_mark, struct inotify_inode_mark,
			      fsn_mark);

	/*
	 */
	old_memcg = set_active_memcg(group->memcg);
	event = kmalloc(alloc_len, GFP_KERNEL_ACCOUNT | __GFP_RETRY_MAYFAIL);
	set_active_memcg(old_memcg);

	if (unlikely(!event)) {
		/*
		 */
		fsnotify_queue_overflow(group);
		return -ENOMEM;
	}

	/*
	 */
	if (mask & (IN_MOVE_SELF | IN_DELETE_SELF))
		mask &= ~IN_ISDIR;

	fsn_event = &event->fse;
	fsnotify_init_event(fsn_event);
	event->mask = mask;
	event->wd = i_mark->wd;
	event->sync_cookie = cookie;
	event->name_len = len;
	if (len)
		strcpy(event->name, name->name);

	ret = fsnotify_add_event(group, fsn_event, inotify_merge);
	if (ret) {
		/* Our event wasn't used in the end. Free it. */
		fsnotify_destroy_event(group, fsn_event);
	}

	if (inode_mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_IN_ONESHOT)
		fsnotify_destroy_mark(inode_mark, group);

	return 0;
}

Source code for filp_close:
int filp_close(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	int retval = 0;

	if (!file_count(filp)) {
		printk(KERN_ERR "VFS: Close: file count is 0\n");
		return 0;
	}

	if (filp->f_op->flush)
		retval = filp->f_op->flush(filp, id);

	if (likely(!(filp->f_mode & FMODE_PATH))) {
		dnotify_flush(filp, id);
		locks_remove_posix(filp, id);
	}
	fput(filp);
	return retval;
}
Source code for dnotify_flush:
void dnotify_flush(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	struct fsnotify_mark *fsn_mark;
	struct dnotify_mark *dn_mark;
	struct dnotify_struct *dn;
	struct dnotify_struct **prev;
	struct inode *inode;
	bool free = false;

	inode = file_inode(filp);
	if (!S_ISDIR(inode->i_mode))
		return;

	fsn_mark = fsnotify_find_mark(&inode->i_fsnotify_marks, dnotify_group);
	if (!fsn_mark)
		return;
	dn_mark = container_of(fsn_mark, struct dnotify_mark, fsn_mark);

	fsnotify_group_lock(dnotify_group);

	spin_lock(&fsn_mark->lock);
	prev = &dn_mark->dn;
	while ((dn = *prev) != NULL) {
		if ((dn->dn_owner == id) && (dn->dn_filp == filp)) {
			*prev = dn->dn_next;
			kmem_cache_free(dnotify_struct_cache, dn);
			dnotify_recalc_inode_mask(fsn_mark);
			break;
		}
		prev = &dn->dn_next;
	}

	spin_unlock(&fsn_mark->lock);

	/* nothing else could have found us thanks to the dnotify_groups
	   mark_mutex */
	if (dn_mark->dn == NULL) {
		fsnotify_detach_mark(fsn_mark);
		free = true;
	}

	fsnotify_group_unlock(dnotify_group);

	if (free)
		fsnotify_free_mark(fsn_mark);
	fsnotify_put_mark(fsn_mark);
}

Source code for __x64_sys_close:
NoneSource code for fsnotify_find_mark:
struct fsnotify_mark *fsnotify_find_mark(fsnotify_connp_t *connp,
					 struct fsnotify_group *group)
{
	struct fsnotify_mark_connector *conn;
	struct fsnotify_mark *mark;

	conn = fsnotify_grab_connector(connp);
	if (!conn)
		return NULL;

	hlist_for_each_entry(mark, &conn->list, obj_list) {
		if (mark->group == group &&
		    (mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED)) {
			fsnotify_get_mark(mark);
			spin_unlock(&conn->lock);
			return mark;
		}
	}
	spin_unlock(&conn->lock);
	return NULL;
}
Source code for fput:
void fput(struct file *file)
{
	if (atomic_long_dec_and_test(&file->f_count)) {
		struct task_struct *task = current;

		if (likely(!in_interrupt() && !(task->flags & PF_KTHREAD))) {
			init_task_work(&file->f_rcuhead, ____fput);
			if (!task_work_add(task, &file->f_rcuhead, TWA_RESUME))
				return;
			/*
			 */
		}

		if (llist_add(&file->f_llist, &delayed_fput_list))
			schedule_delayed_work(&delayed_fput_work, 1);
	}
}
Source code for fsnotify_free_mark:
void fsnotify_free_mark(struct fsnotify_mark *mark)
{
	struct fsnotify_group *group = mark->group;

	spin_lock(&mark->lock);
	/* something else already called this function on this mark */
	if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ALIVE)) {
		spin_unlock(&mark->lock);
		return;
	}
	mark->flags &= ~FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ALIVE;
	spin_unlock(&mark->lock);

	/*
	 */
	if (group->ops->freeing_mark)
		group->ops->freeing_mark(mark, group);
}

static void *__fsnotify_recalc_mask(struct fsnotify_mark_connector *conn)
{
	u32 new_mask = 0;
	bool want_iref = false;
	struct fsnotify_mark *mark;

	assert_spin_locked(&conn->lock);
	/* We can get detached connector here when inode is getting unlinked. */
	if (!fsnotify_valid_obj_type(conn->type))
		return NULL;
	hlist_for_each_entry(mark, &conn->list, obj_list) {
		if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED))
			continue;
		new_mask |= fsnotify_calc_mask(mark);
		if (conn->type == FSNOTIFY_OBJ_TYPE_INODE &&
		    !(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_NO_IREF))
			want_iref = true;
	}
	*fsnotify_conn_mask_p(conn) = new_mask;

	return fsnotify_update_iref(conn, want_iref);
}
Source code for __nfs_commit_inode:
static int __nfs_commit_inode(struct inode *inode, int how,
		struct writeback_control *wbc)
{
	LIST_HEAD(head);
	struct nfs_commit_info cinfo;
	int may_wait = how & FLUSH_SYNC;
	int ret, nscan;

	how &= ~FLUSH_SYNC;
	nfs_init_cinfo_from_inode(&cinfo, inode);
	nfs_commit_begin(cinfo.mds);
	for (;;) {
		ret = nscan = nfs_scan_commit(inode, &head, &cinfo);
		if (ret <= 0)
			break;
		ret = nfs_generic_commit_list(inode, &head, how, &cinfo);
		if (ret < 0)
			break;
		ret = 0;
		if (wbc && wbc->sync_mode == WB_SYNC_NONE) {
			if (nscan < wbc->nr_to_write)
				wbc->nr_to_write -= nscan;
			else
				wbc->nr_to_write = 0;
		}
		if (nscan < INT_MAX)
			break;
		cond_resched();
	}
	nfs_commit_end(cinfo.mds);
	if (ret || !may_wait)
		return ret;
	return wait_on_commit(cinfo.mds);
}

Source code for inotify_remove_from_idr:
static void inotify_remove_from_idr(struct fsnotify_group *group,
				    struct inotify_inode_mark *i_mark)
{
	struct idr *idr = &group->inotify_data.idr;
	spinlock_t *idr_lock = &group->inotify_data.idr_lock;
	struct inotify_inode_mark *found_i_mark = NULL;
	int wd;

	spin_lock(idr_lock);
	wd = i_mark->wd;

	/*
	 */
	if (wd == -1) {
		WARN_ONCE(1, "%s: i_mark=%p i_mark->wd=%d i_mark->group=%p\n",
			__func__, i_mark, i_mark->wd, i_mark->fsn_mark.group);
		goto out;
	}

	/* Lets look in the idr to see if we find it */
	found_i_mark = inotify_idr_find_locked(group, wd);
	if (unlikely(!found_i_mark)) {
		WARN_ONCE(1, "%s: i_mark=%p i_mark->wd=%d i_mark->group=%p\n",
			__func__, i_mark, i_mark->wd, i_mark->fsn_mark.group);
		goto out;
	}

	/*
	 */
	if (unlikely(found_i_mark != i_mark)) {
		WARN_ONCE(1, "%s: i_mark=%p i_mark->wd=%d i_mark->group=%p "
			"found_i_mark=%p found_i_mark->wd=%d "
			"found_i_mark->group=%p\n", __func__, i_mark,
			i_mark->wd, i_mark->fsn_mark.group, found_i_mark,
			found_i_mark->wd, found_i_mark->fsn_mark.group);
		goto out;
	}

	/*
	 */
	if (unlikely(refcount_read(&i_mark->fsn_mark.refcnt) < 2)) {
		printk(KERN_ERR "%s: i_mark=%p i_mark->wd=%d i_mark->group=%p\n",
			 __func__, i_mark, i_mark->wd, i_mark->fsn_mark.group);
		/* we can't really recover with bad ref cnting.. */
		BUG();
	}

	idr_remove(idr, wd);
	/* Removed from the idr, drop that ref. */
	fsnotify_put_mark(&i_mark->fsn_mark);
out:
	i_mark->wd = -1;
	spin_unlock(idr_lock);
	/* match the ref taken by inotify_idr_find_locked() */
	if (found_i_mark)
		fsnotify_put_mark(&found_i_mark->fsn_mark);
}

Source code for filp_close:
int filp_close(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	int retval = 0;

	if (!file_count(filp)) {
		printk(KERN_ERR "VFS: Close: file count is 0\n");
		return 0;
	}

	if (filp->f_op->flush)
		retval = filp->f_op->flush(filp, id);

	if (likely(!(filp->f_mode & FMODE_PATH))) {
		dnotify_flush(filp, id);
		locks_remove_posix(filp, id);
	}
	fput(filp);
	return retval;
}
Source code for dnotify_flush:
void dnotify_flush(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	struct fsnotify_mark *fsn_mark;
	struct dnotify_mark *dn_mark;
	struct dnotify_struct *dn;
	struct dnotify_struct **prev;
	struct inode *inode;
	bool free = false;

	inode = file_inode(filp);
	if (!S_ISDIR(inode->i_mode))
		return;

	fsn_mark = fsnotify_find_mark(&inode->i_fsnotify_marks, dnotify_group);
	if (!fsn_mark)
		return;
	dn_mark = container_of(fsn_mark, struct dnotify_mark, fsn_mark);

	fsnotify_group_lock(dnotify_group);

	spin_lock(&fsn_mark->lock);
	prev = &dn_mark->dn;
	while ((dn = *prev) != NULL) {
		if ((dn->dn_owner == id) && (dn->dn_filp == filp)) {
			*prev = dn->dn_next;
			kmem_cache_free(dnotify_struct_cache, dn);
			dnotify_recalc_inode_mask(fsn_mark);
			break;
		}
		prev = &dn->dn_next;
	}

	spin_unlock(&fsn_mark->lock);

	/* nothing else could have found us thanks to the dnotify_groups
	   mark_mutex */
	if (dn_mark->dn == NULL) {
		fsnotify_detach_mark(fsn_mark);
		free = true;
	}

	fsnotify_group_unlock(dnotify_group);

	if (free)
		fsnotify_free_mark(fsn_mark);
	fsnotify_put_mark(fsn_mark);
}

struct fsnotify_mark *fsnotify_find_mark(fsnotify_connp_t *connp,
					 struct fsnotify_group *group)
{
	struct fsnotify_mark_connector *conn;
	struct fsnotify_mark *mark;

	conn = fsnotify_grab_connector(connp);
	if (!conn)
		return NULL;

	hlist_for_each_entry(mark, &conn->list, obj_list) {
		if (mark->group == group &&
		    (mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED)) {
			fsnotify_get_mark(mark);
			spin_unlock(&conn->lock);
			return mark;
		}
	}
	spin_unlock(&conn->lock);
	return NULL;
}

				return;
			/*
			 */
		}

Source code for fsnotify_free_mark:
void fsnotify_free_mark(struct fsnotify_mark *mark)
{
	struct fsnotify_group *group = mark->group;

	spin_lock(&mark->lock);
	/* something else already called this function on this mark */
	if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ALIVE)) {
		spin_unlock(&mark->lock);
		return;
	}
	mark->flags &= ~FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ALIVE;
	spin_unlock(&mark->lock);

	/*
	 */
	if (group->ops->freeing_mark)
		group->ops->freeing_mark(mark, group);
}

Source code for refcount_warn_saturate:
void refcount_warn_saturate(refcount_t *r, enum refcount_saturation_type t)
{
	refcount_set(r, REFCOUNT_SATURATED);

	switch (t) {
	case REFCOUNT_ADD_NOT_ZERO_OVF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("saturated; leaking memory");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_ADD_OVF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("saturated; leaking memory");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_ADD_UAF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("addition on 0; use-after-free");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_SUB_UAF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("underflow; use-after-free");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_DEC_LEAK:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("decrement hit 0; leaking memory");
		break;
	default:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("unknown saturation event!?");
	}
}

void fsnotify_detach_mark(struct fsnotify_mark *mark)
{
	fsnotify_group_assert_locked(mark->group);
	WARN_ON_ONCE(!srcu_read_lock_held(&fsnotify_mark_srcu) &&
		     refcount_read(&mark->refcnt) < 1 +
			!!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED));

	spin_lock(&mark->lock);
	/* something else already called this function on this mark */
	if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED)) {
		spin_unlock(&mark->lock);
		return;
	}
	mark->flags &= ~FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED;
	list_del_init(&mark->g_list);
	spin_unlock(&mark->lock);

	/* Drop mark reference acquired in fsnotify_add_mark_locked() */
	fsnotify_put_mark(mark);
}

Source code for __queue_delayed_work:
static void __queue_delayed_work(int cpu, struct workqueue_struct *wq,
				struct delayed_work *dwork, unsigned long delay)
{
	struct timer_list *timer = &dwork->timer;
	struct work_struct *work = &dwork->work;

	WARN_ON_ONCE(!wq);
	WARN_ON_ONCE(timer->function != delayed_work_timer_fn);
	WARN_ON_ONCE(timer_pending(timer));
	WARN_ON_ONCE(!list_empty(&work->entry));

	/*
	 */
	if (!delay) {
		__queue_work(cpu, wq, &dwork->work);
		return;
	}

	dwork->wq = wq;
	dwork->cpu = cpu;
	timer->expires = jiffies + delay;

	if (unlikely(cpu != WORK_CPU_UNBOUND))
		add_timer_on(timer, cpu);
	else
		add_timer(timer);
}
Source code for nfs_wb_all:
int nfs_wb_all(struct inode *inode)
{
	int ret;

	trace_nfs_writeback_inode_enter(inode);

	ret = filemap_write_and_wait(inode->i_mapping);
	if (ret)
		goto out;
	ret = nfs_commit_inode(inode, FLUSH_SYNC);
	if (ret < 0)
		goto out;
	pnfs_sync_inode(inode, true);
	ret = 0;

out:
	trace_nfs_writeback_inode_exit(inode, ret);
	return ret;
}

bool nfs4_delegation_flush_on_close(const struct inode *inode)
{
	struct nfs_inode *nfsi = NFS_I(inode);
	struct nfs_delegation *delegation;
	bool ret = true;

	rcu_read_lock();
	delegation = rcu_dereference(nfsi->delegation);
	if (delegation == NULL || !(delegation->type & FMODE_WRITE))
		goto out;
	if (atomic_long_read(&nfsi->nrequests) < delegation->pagemod_limit)
		ret = false;

Source code for __fsnotify_update_child_dentry_flags:
void __fsnotify_update_child_dentry_flags(struct inode *inode)
{
	struct dentry *alias;
	int watched;

	if (!S_ISDIR(inode->i_mode))
		return;

	/* determine if the children should tell inode about their events */
	watched = fsnotify_inode_watches_children(inode);

	spin_lock(&inode->i_lock);
	/* run all of the dentries associated with this inode.  Since this is a
	 * directory, there damn well better only be one item on this list */
	hlist_for_each_entry(alias, &inode->i_dentry, d_u.d_alias) {
		struct dentry *child;

		/* run all of the children of the original inode and fix their
		 * original inode) */
		spin_lock(&alias->d_lock);
		list_for_each_entry(child, &alias->d_subdirs, d_child) {
			if (!child->d_inode)
				continue;

			spin_lock_nested(&child->d_lock, DENTRY_D_LOCK_NESTED);
			if (watched)
				child->d_flags |= DCACHE_FSNOTIFY_PARENT_WATCHED;
			else
				child->d_flags &= ~DCACHE_FSNOTIFY_PARENT_WATCHED;
			spin_unlock(&child->d_lock);
		}
		spin_unlock(&alias->d_lock);
	}
	spin_unlock(&inode->i_lock);
}

static int __nfs_commit_inode(struct inode *inode, int how,
		struct writeback_control *wbc)
{
	LIST_HEAD(head);
	struct nfs_commit_info cinfo;
	int may_wait = how & FLUSH_SYNC;
	int ret, nscan;

	how &= ~FLUSH_SYNC;
	nfs_init_cinfo_from_inode(&cinfo, inode);

		if (ret <= 0)
			break;
		ret = nfs_generic_commit_list(inode, &head, how, &cinfo);
		if (ret < 0)
			break;

			if (nscan < wbc->nr_to_write)
				wbc->nr_to_write -= nscan;
			else
				wbc->nr_to_write = 0;
		}
		if (nscan < INT_MAX)
			break;
		cond_resched();
	}
	nfs_commit_end(cinfo.mds);
	if (ret || !may_wait)
		return ret;
	return wait_on_commit(cinfo.mds);
}

	struct fsnotify_mark *fsn_mark;
	struct dnotify_mark *dn_mark;
	struct dnotify_struct *dn;
	struct dnotify_struct **prev;
	struct inode *inode;
	bool free = false;

	inode = file_inode(filp);
	if (!S_ISDIR(inode->i_mode))
		return;

	fsn_mark = fsnotify_find_mark(&inode->i_fsnotify_marks, dnotify_group);
	if (!fsn_mark)
		return;
	dn_mark = container_of(fsn_mark, struct dnotify_mark, fsn_mark);

	fsnotify_group_lock(dnotify_group);

	spin_lock(&fsn_mark->lock);
	prev = &dn_mark->dn;
	while ((dn = *prev) != NULL) {
		if ((dn->dn_owner == id) && (dn->dn_filp == filp)) {
			*prev = dn->dn_next;
			kmem_cache_free(dnotify_struct_cache, dn);
			dnotify_recalc_inode_mask(fsn_mark);
			break;
		}
		prev = &dn->dn_next;
	}

	spin_unlock(&fsn_mark->lock);

	/* nothing else could have found us thanks to the dnotify_groups
	   mark_mutex */
	if (dn_mark->dn == NULL) {
		fsnotify_detach_mark(fsn_mark);
		free = true;
	}

	fsnotify_group_unlock(dnotify_group);

	if (free)
		fsnotify_free_mark(fsn_mark);
	fsnotify_put_mark(fsn_mark);
}

struct fsnotify_mark *fsnotify_find_mark(fsnotify_connp_t *connp,
					 struct fsnotify_group *group)
{
	struct fsnotify_mark_connector *conn;
	struct fsnotify_mark *mark;

	conn = fsnotify_grab_connector(connp);
	if (!conn)
		return NULL;

	hlist_for_each_entry(mark, &conn->list, obj_list) {
		if (mark->group == group &&
		    (mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED)) {
			fsnotify_get_mark(mark);
			spin_unlock(&conn->lock);
			return mark;
		}
	}
	spin_unlock(&conn->lock);
	return NULL;
}

void fput(struct file *file)
{
	if (atomic_long_dec_and_test(&file->f_count)) {
		struct task_struct *task = current;

		if (likely(!in_interrupt() && !(task->flags & PF_KTHREAD))) {
			init_task_work(&file->f_rcuhead, ____fput);
			if (!task_work_add(task, &file->f_rcuhead, TWA_RESUME))
				return;
			/*
			 */
		}

		if (llist_add(&file->f_llist, &delayed_fput_list))
			schedule_delayed_work(&delayed_fput_work, 1);
	}
}
Source code for fsnotify_free_mark:
void fsnotify_free_mark(struct fsnotify_mark *mark)
{
	struct fsnotify_group *group = mark->group;

	spin_lock(&mark->lock);
	/* something else already called this function on this mark */
	if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ALIVE)) {
		spin_unlock(&mark->lock);
		return;
	}
	mark->flags &= ~FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ALIVE;
	spin_unlock(&mark->lock);

	/*
	 */
	if (group->ops->freeing_mark)
		group->ops->freeing_mark(mark, group);
}

		return;

	spin_lock(&conn->lock);
	__fsnotify_recalc_mask(conn);
	spin_unlock(&conn->lock);

		__fsnotify_update_child_dentry_flags(

bool queue_delayed_work_on(int cpu, struct workqueue_struct *wq,
			   struct delayed_work *dwork, unsigned long delay)
{
	struct work_struct *work = &dwork->work;
	bool ret = false;
	unsigned long flags;

	/* read the comment in __queue_work() */
	local_irq_save(flags);

	if (!test_and_set_bit(WORK_STRUCT_PENDING_BIT, work_data_bits(work))) {
		__queue_delayed_work(cpu, wq, dwork, delay);
		ret = true;
	}

	local_irq_restore(flags);
	return ret;
}
Source code for refcount_warn_saturate:
void refcount_warn_saturate(refcount_t *r, enum refcount_saturation_type t)
{
	refcount_set(r, REFCOUNT_SATURATED);

	switch (t) {
	case REFCOUNT_ADD_NOT_ZERO_OVF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("saturated; leaking memory");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_ADD_OVF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("saturated; leaking memory");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_ADD_UAF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("addition on 0; use-after-free");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_SUB_UAF:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("underflow; use-after-free");
		break;
	case REFCOUNT_DEC_LEAK:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("decrement hit 0; leaking memory");
		break;
	default:
		REFCOUNT_WARN("unknown saturation event!?");
	}
}

void fsnotify_detach_mark(struct fsnotify_mark *mark)
{
	fsnotify_group_assert_locked(mark->group);
	WARN_ON_ONCE(!srcu_read_lock_held(&fsnotify_mark_srcu) &&
		     refcount_read(&mark->refcnt) < 1 +
			!!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED));

	spin_lock(&mark->lock);
	/* something else already called this function on this mark */
	if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED)) {
		spin_unlock(&mark->lock);
		return;
	}
	mark->flags &= ~FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED;
	list_del_init(&mark->g_list);
	spin_unlock(&mark->lock);

	/* Drop mark reference acquired in fsnotify_add_mark_locked() */
	fsnotify_put_mark(mark);
}

Source code for __queue_delayed_work:
static void __queue_delayed_work(int cpu, struct workqueue_struct *wq,
				struct delayed_work *dwork, unsigned long delay)
{
	struct timer_list *timer = &dwork->timer;
	struct work_struct *work = &dwork->work;

	WARN_ON_ONCE(!wq);
	WARN_ON_ONCE(timer->function != delayed_work_timer_fn);
	WARN_ON_ONCE(timer_pending(timer));
	WARN_ON_ONCE(!list_empty(&work->entry));

	/*
	 */
	if (!delay) {
		__queue_work(cpu, wq, &dwork->work);
		return;
	}

	dwork->wq = wq;
	dwork->cpu = cpu;
	timer->expires = jiffies + delay;

	if (unlikely(cpu != WORK_CPU_UNBOUND))
		add_timer_on(timer, cpu);
	else
		add_timer(timer);
}
Source code for nfs_wb_all:
int nfs_wb_all(struct inode *inode)
{
	int ret;

	trace_nfs_writeback_inode_enter(inode);

	ret = filemap_write_and_wait(inode->i_mapping);
	if (ret)
		goto out;
	ret = nfs_commit_inode(inode, FLUSH_SYNC);
	if (ret < 0)
		goto out;
	pnfs_sync_inode(inode, true);
	ret = 0;

out:
	trace_nfs_writeback_inode_exit(inode, ret);
	return ret;
}
Source code for nfs4_delegation_flush_on_close:
bool nfs4_delegation_flush_on_close(const struct inode *inode)
{
	struct nfs_inode *nfsi = NFS_I(inode);
	struct nfs_delegation *delegation;
	bool ret = true;

	rcu_read_lock();
	delegation = rcu_dereference(nfsi->delegation);
	if (delegation == NULL || !(delegation->type & FMODE_WRITE))
		goto out;
	if (atomic_long_read(&nfsi->nrequests) < delegation->pagemod_limit)
		ret = false;
out:
	rcu_read_unlock();
	return ret;
}
Source code for __fsnotify_update_child_dentry_flags:
void __fsnotify_update_child_dentry_flags(struct inode *inode)
{
	struct dentry *alias;
	int watched;

	if (!S_ISDIR(inode->i_mode))
		return;

	/* determine if the children should tell inode about their events */
	watched = fsnotify_inode_watches_children(inode);

	spin_lock(&inode->i_lock);
	/* run all of the dentries associated with this inode.  Since this is a
	 * directory, there damn well better only be one item on this list */
	hlist_for_each_entry(alias, &inode->i_dentry, d_u.d_alias) {
		struct dentry *child;

		/* run all of the children of the original inode and fix their
		 * original inode) */
		spin_lock(&alias->d_lock);
		list_for_each_entry(child, &alias->d_subdirs, d_child) {
			if (!child->d_inode)
				continue;

			spin_lock_nested(&child->d_lock, DENTRY_D_LOCK_NESTED);
			if (watched)
				child->d_flags |= DCACHE_FSNOTIFY_PARENT_WATCHED;
			else
				child->d_flags &= ~DCACHE_FSNOTIFY_PARENT_WATCHED;
			spin_unlock(&child->d_lock);
		}
		spin_unlock(&alias->d_lock);
	}
	spin_unlock(&inode->i_lock);
}
Source code for __fsnotify_recalc_mask:
static void *__fsnotify_recalc_mask(struct fsnotify_mark_connector *conn)
{
	u32 new_mask = 0;
	bool want_iref = false;
	struct fsnotify_mark *mark;

	assert_spin_locked(&conn->lock);
	/* We can get detached connector here when inode is getting unlinked. */
	if (!fsnotify_valid_obj_type(conn->type))
		return NULL;
	hlist_for_each_entry(mark, &conn->list, obj_list) {
		if (!(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_ATTACHED))
			continue;
		new_mask |= fsnotify_calc_mask(mark);
		if (conn->type == FSNOTIFY_OBJ_TYPE_INODE &&
		    !(mark->flags & FSNOTIFY_MARK_FLAG_NO_IREF))
			want_iref = true;
	}
	*fsnotify_conn_mask_p(conn) = new_mask;

	return fsnotify_update_iref(conn, want_iref);
}
Source code for __nfs_commit_inode:
static int __nfs_commit_inode(struct inode *inode, int how,
		struct writeback_control *wbc)
{
	LIST_HEAD(head);
	struct nfs_commit_info cinfo;
	int may_wait = how & FLUSH_SYNC;
	int ret, nscan;

	how &= ~FLUSH_SYNC;
	nfs_init_cinfo_from_inode(&cinfo, inode);
	nfs_commit_begin(cinfo.mds);
	for (;;) {
		ret = nscan = nfs_scan_commit(inode, &head, &cinfo);
		if (ret <= 0)
			break;
		ret = nfs_generic_commit_list(inode, &head, how, &cinfo);
		if (ret < 0)
			break;
		ret = 0;
		if (wbc && wbc->sync_mode == WB_SYNC_NONE) {
			if (nscan < wbc->nr_to_write)
				wbc->nr_to_write -= nscan;
			else
				wbc->nr_to_write = 0;
		}
		if (nscan < INT_MAX)
			break;
		cond_resched();
	}
	nfs_commit_end(cinfo.mds);
	if (ret || !may_wait)
		return ret;
	return wait_on_commit(cinfo.mds);
}
Source code for inotify_ignored_and_remove_idr:
void inotify_ignored_and_remove_idr(struct fsnotify_mark *fsn_mark,
				    struct fsnotify_group *group)
{
	struct inotify_inode_mark *i_mark;

	/* Queue ignore event for the watch */
	inotify_handle_inode_event(fsn_mark, FS_IN_IGNORED, NULL, NULL, NULL,
				   0);

	i_mark = container_of(fsn_mark, struct inotify_inode_mark, fsn_mark);
	/* remove this mark from the idr */
	inotify_remove_from_idr(group, i_mark);

	dec_inotify_watches(group->inotify_data.ucounts);
}
Source code for put_pid_ns:
void put_pid_ns(struct pid_namespace *ns)
{
	struct pid_namespace *parent;

	while (ns != &init_pid_ns) {
		parent = ns->parent;
		if (!refcount_dec_and_test(&ns->ns.count))
			break;
		destroy_pid_namespace(ns);
		ns = parent;
	}
}

void finish_wait(struct wait_queue_head *wq_head, struct wait_queue_entry *wq_entry)
{
	unsigned long flags;

	__set_current_state(TASK_RUNNING);
	/*
	 */
	if (!list_empty_careful(&wq_entry->entry)) {
		spin_lock_irqsave(&wq_head->lock, flags);

Source code for filp_close:
int filp_close(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	int retval = 0;

	if (!file_count(filp)) {
		printk(KERN_ERR "VFS: Close: file count is 0\n");
		return 0;
	}

	if (filp->f_op->flush)
		retval = filp->f_op->flush(filp, id);

	if (likely(!(filp->f_mode & FMODE_PATH))) {
		dnotify_flush(filp, id);
		locks_remove_posix(filp, id);
	}
	fput(filp);
	return retval;
}
Source code for dnotify_flush:
void dnotify_flush(struct file *filp, fl_owner_t id)
{
	struct fsnotify_mark *fsn_mark;
	struct dnotify_mark *dn_mark;
	struct dnotify_struct *dn;
	struct dnotify_struct **prev;
	struct inode *inode;
	bool free = false;

	inode = file_inode(filp);
	if (!S_ISDIR(inode->i_mode))
		return;

	fsn_mark = fsnotify_find_mark(&inode->i_fsnotify_marks, dnotify_group);
	if (!fsn_mark)
		return;
	dn_mark = container_of(fsn_mark, struct dnotify_mark, fsn_mark);

	fsnotify_group_lock(dnotify_group);

	spin_lock(&fsn_mark->lock);
	prev = &dn_mark->dn;
	while ((dn = *prev) != NULL) {
		if ((dn->dn_owner == id) && (dn->dn_filp == filp)) {
			*prev = dn->dn_next;
			kmem_cache_free(dnotify_struct_cache, dn);
			dnotify_recalc_inode_mask(fsn_mark);
			break;
		}
		prev = &dn->dn_next;
	}

	spin_unlock(&fsn_mark->lock);

	/* nothing else could have found us thanks to the dnotify_groups
	   mark_mutex */
	if (dn_mark->dn == NULL) {
		fsnotify_detach_mark(fsn_mark);
		free = true;
	}

	fsnotify_group_unlock(dnotify_group);

	if (free)
		fsnotify_free_mark(fsn_mark);
	fsnotify_put_mark(fsn_mark);
}
